headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 16, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory behind Jesús Luzardo's 7.0 innings of work. In other action, the Washington Nationals took down the Kansas City Royals 6-4, while the Toronto Blue Jays cruised past the Boston Red Sox 6-1.

Injuries have started to take their toll on several teams. The Cleveland Guardians placed RF Chase DeLauter on the 10-day injured list due to a right side rib fracture. The Toronto Blue Jays also placed RHP Max Scherzer on the 15-day injured list with back spasms. The Detroit Tigers placed 2B Gleyber Torres on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain, while the Seattle Mariners transferred 3B Will Wilson to the 60-day injured list with a left thumb fracture.

Several teams made roster moves in the past 24 hours. The Kansas City Royals traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold. The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, while the Cleveland Guardians traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Rout Marlins 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing an 8-2 victory. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to the win, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Royals 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 4-6 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Paxton Schultz earning the win and Gus Varland securing the save. Curtis Mead led the Royals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 6-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Cease earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 0 ER, 4 BB, 4 H. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, 3 RBI, and 3 AB, including a key home run that scored Myles Straw.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout White Sox 12-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Chicago White Sox, securing a 12-2 victory. José Caballero led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including his 7th home run of the season.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Reds 9-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds in a lopsided 9-1 victory. Jorge Polanco and Christian Scott were key contributors in the win.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Nationals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Carter Jensen and Michael Massey contributing to the winning effort. Lane Thomas and John Rave also made notable impacts in the game.

top_news.title: **Guardians Place Chase DeLauter on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Cleveland Guardians right fielder Chase DeLauter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right side rib fracture, effective retroactive to June 14, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-hander Denis Samudio and cash.
